text: The Budget Committee at its meeting of February 13, 2019: 1. Deferred the consideration of item BU3.3 to the February 20, 2019 meeting of the Budget Committee along with the following motion: Motion 2 by Councillor Brad Bradford (placed at Budget Committee meeting on February 4 and 6, 2019): "That City Council request the Toronto Parking Authority Board to request the President, Toronto Parking Authority to report to Budget Committee on the following for consideration prior to the 2020 Budget Process: 1. ridership changes at Bike Share stations directly adjacent to the Richmond/Adelaide and Bloor St W bike lanes, from before implementation to implementation. 2. the feasibility and financial impact of extending Bike Share travel times from 30 minutes to 45 minutes for annual members."
